description: This PHP source file defines the 'OAuthClient' entity class used in the OrangeHRM system. The class maps to the 'ohrm_oauth2_client' database table and includes properties such as id, name, clientId, clientSecret, redirectUri, confidential, and enabled, along with corresponding getter and setter methods.

classes.name: OAuthClient
classes.description: Entity class representing an OAuth 2.0 client with properties mapped to the database table 'ohrm_oauth2_client'. It includes configuration for client identification, secret, redirection URI, confidentiality, and enabled status.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the OAuth client.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the OAuth client.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the OAuth client.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the OAuth client.

methods.name: getClientId
methods.description: Returns the client ID used for OAuth identification.

methods.name: setClientId
methods.description: Sets the client ID for OAuth identification.

methods.name: getClientSecret
methods.description: Returns the client secret if set.

methods.name: getRedirectUri
methods.description: Returns the redirect URI registered for OAuth flows.

methods.name: isConfidential
methods.description: Checks if the client is confidential.

methods.name: setConfidential
methods.description: Sets whether the client is confidential.

methods.name: isEnabled
methods.description: Checks if the OAuth client is enabled.

methods.name: setEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables the OAuth client.
